Usage: spec-driven-steroids uninstall [options]

Remove manifest-tracked SDS files for a platform and scope

Options:
  --platform <platform>  Limit to one platform
  --scope <scope>        Scope: global or project (default: "global")
  --project              Shortcut for --scope project
  --force                Remove files even if modified
  --dry-run              Show what would be removed
  --json                 Emit JSON
  -y, --yes              Skip confirmation prompt
  -h, --help             display help for command
